purpose: Tagged PDFs whose tables are drawn without rules: wrapped, vertically centred cells (borderless-table), and the browser default style with cells a few pixels apart (default-table). Only the structure tree gives their rows and cells. table-beside-prose puts a small table among long paragraphs, so the table holds far less than half of its band. wrapped-table has neither header cells nor rules, so Chrome tags it as a layout table, without a Table in the structure tree: only the geometry of its wrapped, vertically centred cells gives its rows, and its last rows continue on the next page without a header.
authored: written for these tests in markitai-rust
